## RecipeTransferPlan

```java
public record RecipeTransferPlan(ResourceLocation recipeId, List<ItemStack> expectedMatrix, List<ItemStack> expectedSources, List<ItemStack> nextMatrix, List<ItemStack> nextSources, int sets)
```

A server-prepared inventory rearrangement. Expected values are compare-and-set fences, not permission to recreate missing items. No result stack or wand debit is included.

```java
public RecipeTransferPlan(ResourceLocation recipeId, List<ItemStack> expectedMatrix, List<ItemStack> expectedSources, List<ItemStack> nextMatrix, List<ItemStack> nextSources, int sets)
public List<ItemStack> expectedMatrix()
public List<ItemStack> expectedSources()
public List<ItemStack> nextMatrix()
public List<ItemStack> nextSources()
```

## RecipeTransferTarget

```java
public interface RecipeTransferTarget
```

Implement on the actual open menu. This API has no dependency on any storage addon. Matrix slots are 0..8; other slots (including the wand) are never transfer ingredients.

```java
Container recipeTransferContents()
```

<a id="recipetransfertarget-cantransferrecipe"></a>
```java
boolean canTransferRecipe(ServerPlayer actor)
```

Rechecks actor, open session, block/reach, and any external inventory permissions.

<a id="recipetransfertarget-recipetransfersourcesnapshot"></a>
```java
default List<ItemStack> recipeTransferSourceSnapshot(ServerPlayer actor)
```

Stable ordered source cells. The default uses only the player's 36 main/hotbar cells.

<a id="recipetransfertarget-applyrecipetransfer"></a>
```java
boolean applyRecipeTransfer(ServerPlayer actor, RecipeTransferPlan plan)
```

Atomically validate expected cells and replace BOTH matrix and source cells before notifications. Return true once committed, even if a later callback retires the menu. An addon providing another source must implement equivalent conservation/rollback; a simulated network extraction is not a paid ingredient.
